descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Blocks are falling from the sky onto a floating island, and they're all yours.

Block Collectors is a VR collecting game where you move with your arms and grab blocks with your hands. Pull them in from across the island, stack them up and hurl them into the stormy sea below. Every splash pays, and your coins fly straight into the watch on your wrist.

COLLECT
• 28 rarities, from everyday blocks to ultra-rare glowing, rainbow and galaxy ones
• Rare finds shoot a beam of light into the sky
• Fill your Block Index for bonus luck

UPGRADE
• Spend cash on luck, money, reach and bigger stacks
• Grow huge upgrade trees with gems from rare blocks
• Luck events like Meteor Showers, Golden Rushes and Galaxy Storms rain down better blocks

FIGHT
• Giant boss blocks crash onto your island
• Hit their glowing weak spots, brace for their shockwaves and win a shower of loot
• Mega and Titan bosses for the brave

BUILD
• Draw conveyor belts and add machines that upgrade, launch, copy and sell blocks
• Your factory keeps earning while you're away

HATCH
• Smash boss eggs on the ground to hatch 20 pets across 7 rarities
• Pets roll up blocks like a snowball and go BOOM to sell them

REBIRTH
• Start over stronger and earn Stars for 95 permanent upgrades
• Unlock new machines and tougher bosses

Plus 60 trophies, 4 save files and plenty of comfort options.

How big can your block empire grow?
